title: Test acceleration
summary: Shared reference for making Agent Studio's tests and the code behind them massively faster. Measured baseline of 2026-10-11 (one review verification 131 min, backend suite 85-93 min, 4 percent of tests carry 97 percent of test time, contention from six parallel suites, inert parallelism flag, full-suite reruns; Playwright on one worker with 365 fixed sleeps and compiled servers), slow tests as a signal of slow code, a layered frontend test strategy, a lever catalogue P1-P6, B1-B10, F1-F12, targets, open decisions D1-D2 and the live reports of the backend track AGT-3049 and the frontend track AGT-3050.
